faq.q: Where do Tsawwassen condos under $800K actually sit?
faq.a: On the page text read for this file, the feed's cards are labelled Tsawwassen East, Tsawwassen North, Cliff Drive, Boundary Beach and Tsawwassen Central — town-centre and Beach Grove-side buildings, Tsawwassen Springs-area and Tsawwassen North buildings, and a Southlands building at Market Avenue.

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer use the PTT exemption under $800K in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: In principle, yes, on a property the program covers — the first time home buyers' program's full exemption runs to a fair market value of $835,000 (exempting the first $500,000 of price), with a partial exemption to $860,000, provided the buyer meets all the program's personal and property conditions; the exemption is claimed through the buyer's legal professional on the PTT return.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Tsawwassen condo?
faq.a: School District 37, address-based. The Tsawwassen schools confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file are South Park, Beach Grove, Cliff Drive, English Bluff and Pebble Hill Traditional elementaries and South Delta Secondary — but a catchment is assigned by address, not by building, so check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator.
